plugins.description: The core of AK's development standards: always-on coding rules, the production guard and the code gate (security and testing), with the skills every project needs — the clean/secure change and bug-fix workflow, security, testing, project templates, delivery and AI engineering. Domain plugins (arkar-ui, …) build on it.
